sonnet.problem: The card asks the baker to guess what the pot says to the potter. Nothing on the earlier cards lets a baker reason to "He did not make me". The made-up wrong answers ("too small", "in a hurry") are the more natural complaints. The pick comes down to luck, and it amounts to guessing the wording of a line.
sonnet.rule: Never ask the baker to guess the next words of a line. / The check: could a thoughtful baker who has only seen the earlier cards make a reasoned pick? If the only way to get it right is luck, give the story card more context or ask a different question.
